serp_ownership.read: vendors own the results page — paid acquisition is likely the only door

revenue_estimate.note: No observed price — revenue left unestimated rather than inferred from search volume.

negative_signals: 5 Product Hunt launches in this space
vendors own the buyer-intent results page — paid may be the only channel

claude_analysis.tam_assessment: This is a niche market: the search results are mostly format documentation and free open-source tools (mne.tools, teuniz.net/EDFbrowser, paulbourke.net), there is no Google Trends signal, there are 0 Hacker News results, and the 6 Reddit hits are mostly unrelated (e.g. r/CrackSupport), so demand is limited to EEG research labs, clinics and BCI hobbyists.
claude_analysis.pricing_assessment: No competitor price was observed, so ~$100/yr is an assumption; willingness to pay looks weak because free converters (convert.guru, MNE-Python, EDFbrowser) and vendor-supplied export tools already cover common formats like EDF, BDF and CSV.
claude_analysis.legal_reasoning: The regulatory probe found 0 restriction hits and 0 government sources, so no licensing or standing restriction surfaced for a file-conversion tool that isn't sold as a medical device.
key_risks: Free open-source tools (MNE-Python, EDFbrowser) and free web converters (convert.guru, Convertio) set the price anchor at $0
EEG hardware vendors (BioSemi, NeuroScan, BESA) document their formats and include export tools with their software, which reduces the need for a standalone converter
Vendors hold 30% of the results page and the audience is small, so paid acquisition costs could exceed ~$100/yr per-customer revenue
key_opportunities: Many proprietary formats and no clear standard (the psychology.stackexchange question asks exactly this), which creates friction for multi-site or multi-vendor research
The consumer and BCI hardware market (e.g. OpenBCI users on r/BCI) needs simple, no-code conversion to research formats
A possible upsell to BIDS-compliant conversion and validation for labs preparing data for publication or sharing
claude_analysis.value_reasoning: About 10,000 potential customers × about $100/yr each (an assumed price, since none was observed) ≈ $1,000,000 total addressable annual revenue.
claude_analysis.probability_reasoning: Competition is rated crowded, which caps probability at 0.10, but mature free tools already meet the core need, so realistic paid penetration is likely under 1% of an already niche market.
